signals.title: PEJ commissions Westinghouse to start long-lead-item procurement for the first AP1000 unit
signals.summary: PEJ commissioned Westinghouse to begin procuring long-lead items for the first AP1000 unit at Lubiatowo-Kopalino, covering six nuclear-island components, after agreeing main EPC commercial terms; the government targets first power in 2036.

signals.title: Spain launches capacity market via auctions, with key rules that support energy storage
signals.summary: Spain launches capacity market via auctions, with key rules that support energy storage ESS News

signals.title: URE publishes approval of Capacity Market Rule update RRM/Z/16/2026
signals.summary: URE published its decision approving capacity-market rule update RRM/Z/16/2026, which PSE announced on 10 September 2026. It is the latest formal change to the capacity-market rules recorded in the official register.

signals.title: Enea H1 2026: net profit falls to 1.50bn zł as EBITDA slips to 2.75bn on weaker generation
signals.summary: Enea reported H1 2026 revenue of PLN 12.82bn, EBITDA of PLN 2.75bn (H1 2025: 3.39bn) and net profit of PLN 1.50bn, down from 2.02bn, as generation margins weakened while Kozienice CCGT construction continued.

links.label: Enea IR — preliminary H1 2026 & Q2 2026 results

signals.title: PGE H1 2026: sales up and net profit swings to ~2.0bn zł as distribution and lower CO2 costs lift EBITDA
signals.summary: PGE’s H1 2026 report showed Q2 sales of PLN 15.26bn (+11% y/y), EBITDA of PLN 4.11bn (+23%) and net profit of about PLN 2.0bn, versus a prior-year loss, with net debt/EBITDA around 0.15x.

signals.title: India adds 8.2 GWh of new BESS capacity in H1 2026 - Energy Storage
signals.summary: India adds 8.2 GWh of new BESS capacity in H1 2026 - Energy Storage ESS News

signals.title: Enea Operator installs 6,500+ transformers as it deploys ~PLN 9bn KPO loan for a smart grid
signals.summary: Enea Operator has installed more than 6,500 transformers across rural Poland, upgrading medium- and low-voltage networks with a ~PLN 9bn BGK/KPO loan, part of plans to invest about PLN 41bn in distribution by 2035.

signals.title: TAURON H1 2026: net profit falls 24% to 1.56bn zł but the dividend returns
signals.summary: TAURON reported H1 2026 net profit of PLN 1.56bn, down 24%, and EBITDA of PLN 3.7bn, with distribution providing 64% of earnings. Revenue rose to PLN 17.2bn and the group signalled a return to dividends.

links.label: WNP — TAURON profit down, revenue up

signals.title: Poland's 2027 supplementary auction contracts full 7.5 GW; clears at 325.55 PLN/kW-year
signals.summary: PSE’s 2027 supplementary capacity auction, held on 3 September 2026, contracted about 7,481 MW at a clearing price of PLN 325.55/kW/year, with PGE, Enea, TAURON and ZE PAK securing most volume on existing conventional units.

signals.title: Enea locks ~1,595 MW in the 2027 supplementary auction, lifting 2027 capacity revenue to ~1.3bn zł
signals.summary: Enea won at least 1,595 MW in the 2027 supplementary auction, worth about PLN 519m, mostly from Kozienice units. It now holds roughly 3,547 MW of 2027 obligations and expects about PLN 1.3bn of 2027 capacity revenue.

signals.title: ENGIE acquires a 438 MW / 876 MWh battery-storage project in Poland
signals.summary: ENGIE Zielona Energia acquired the SPV developing a 438 MW / 876 MWh battery project at Trębaczew, Łódź province, from Mithra Energy and a Futureal Group member. Ready-to-build status is expected in Q4 2026, with commissioning planned for Q1 2029.

signals.unit: Energa Storage — BESS Grudziądz (47 MW) & PV+BESS
signals.title: Energa Storage tenders the BESS Grudziądz 47 MW integrator and advances 13 PV-plus-storage projects
signals.summary: Energa Storage tendered an EMS/SCADA integrator for the 47 MW BESS Grudziądz, with bids due 23 September 2026, and re-ran a contractor tender for 13 PV and storage projects co-funded by the Modernisation Fund.

links.label: Energa Storage — BESS Grudziądz 47 MW tender
Renewables Now — Energa seeks contractor for solar & battery

signals.title: PGE's 262 MW Żarnowiec battery nears commissioning as Poland's largest storage facility
signals.summary: PGE’s 262 MW battery storage installation at Żarnowiec is nearing commissioning and will become Poland’s largest BESS, overtaking the 200 MW / 800 MWh Nowa Wieś Ełcka facility and supporting capacity-market and balancing revenues.

links.label: Renewables Now — PGE 262 MW Żarnowiec near commissioning

signals.title: Van Oord completes all 111 Baltica 2 foundations, keeping PGE's 1.5 GW wind farm on schedule
signals.summary: Van Oord installed the last of 111 monopile foundations for the PGE–Ørsted Baltica 2 offshore wind farm on 21 August 2026, completing the campaign on schedule; secondary structures continue into late 2026.

signals.title: Orlen's 560 MW Gdańsk CCGT advances; Polimex–Siemens on site, foundations due H2 2026
signals.summary: Construction of the 560 MW Gdańsk CCGT is advancing, with a Polimex-Mostostal and Siemens Energy consortium on site, main foundation works in H2 2026, turbines arriving in 2027 and operation required by 2029.

links.label: WNP — Orlen starts Gdańsk gas block

signals.title: Drought cuts ~1.3 GW as Enea reduces output at Kozienice and Połaniec
signals.summary: In early August 2026 Enea cut output at its Kozienice and Połaniec coal plants after low Vistula flows starved cooling systems, removing about 1.3 GW and highlighting water-stress risk for thermal fleets.

signals.title: Energa H1 2026: net profit up 56% to 1.32bn zł, EBITDA 2.72bn on distribution and renewables
signals.summary: Energa reported H1 2026 net profit of PLN 1.32bn, up 56%, and EBITDA of PLN 2.72bn, up 25%, with distribution contributing 71%, on higher network volumes, a retail recovery and expanded renewables.

signals.title: PEJ hands the nuclear site to Bechtel as earthworks begin with Budimex
signals.summary: General contractor Bechtel took over coordination of the Lubiatowo-Kopalino nuclear site from PEJ and earthworks began, carried out by Polish contractor Budimex, reflecting the project’s commitment to maximising Polish local content.

signals.unit: EIB–TAURON financing — Miejska Górka wind farm
signals.title: EIB signs more than €260m financing for TAURON’s 190 MW Miejska Górka wind farm
signals.summary: The European Investment Bank signed more than €260 million (PLN 1.12 billion) of financing for TAURON’s 190 MW Miejska Górka onshore wind farm in western Poland, which TAURON plans to bring into operation in 2027.

signals.title: TAURON passes 3 million smart meters — half its customers — as grid digitalisation accelerates
signals.summary: TAURON Dystrybucja has installed over 3 million remote-reading smart meters, covering about half its roughly 5.6 million customers, supported by Modernisation Fund co-financing and enabling dynamic tariffs, demand management and renewable integration.

signals.title: Gas-turbine backlogs balloon — GE Vernova hits 116 GW, wait times reach seven years
signals.summary: GE Vernova’s gas-turbine backlog reached 116 GW in Q2 2026 while Siemens Energy reported a record order book. With only three large-turbine makers, delivery slots are a binding constraint for Poland’s gas-plant pipeline.

links.label: Utility Dive — backlog climbs to 116 GW

signals.title: TGE, Enea Operator, Energa-Operator and PGE Dystrybucja agree national flexibility platform
signals.summary: TGE, Enea Operator, Energa-Operator and PGE Dystrybucja agreed to build a common national platform where distribution operators can buy flexibility from active consumers, storage, generators and aggregators to manage local grid constraints and connect new resources.

signals.title: Energy Ministry and TAURON sign strategic letter on large-scale energy storage
signals.summary: The Ministry of Energy and TAURON signed a strategic letter of intent to develop regulatory, organisational and financial solutions that accelerate large-scale energy-storage investment, including the Rożnów II pumped-storage project in southern Poland.

signals.title: CCGT Grudziądz delivers first power to Poland's grid — key Orlen gas milestone
signals.summary: CCGT Grudziądz fed electricity to Poland’s national grid for the first time after first firing and synchronisation, entering final commissioning. ORLEN says the plant will supply about one million households once in commercial operation.

signals.title: TAURON signs Ansaldo Energia for the Jaworzno turbine island, resolving its supply risk
signals.summary: TAURON Wytwarzanie signed a €293m contract with Ansaldo Energia for the Jaworzno OCGT turbine island — two 314.6 MW gas turbines — plus a long-term service agreement, with deliveries in late 2028 and 2029.

signals.title: Poland's battery build-out accelerates; 600 MW Siedlce project set to be the country's largest
signals.summary: Greenvolt signed a BYD supply deal for the 600 MW / 2.4 GWh Siedlce battery project, set to become Poland’s largest, as national battery-storage capacity is expected to roughly triple to about 1.3 GW in 2026.

signals.title: ORLEN Synthos Green Energy applies for a CfD covering 14 BWRX-300 SMRs at three sites
signals.summary: ORLEN Synthos Green Energy applied to the Energy Minister for a Contract for Difference covering 14 BWRX-300 SMRs at Włocławek, Stawy Monowskie and Stalowa Wola, the first phase of a 26-unit programme.

links.label: World Nuclear News — OSGE CfD application

signals.unit: ENGIE — Tursko Wielkie BESS (250 MW / 1,000 MWh)
signals.title: ENGIE agrees to acquire R.Power’s ready-to-build 250 MW / 1,000 MWh battery project at Tursko Wielkie
signals.summary: ENGIE Zielona Energia agreed to acquire R.Power’s ready-to-build 250 MW / 1,000 MWh battery project at Tursko Wielkie, Świętokrzyskie. Construction is due to start in early 2027, with commissioning in Q4 2028 and direct connection to the Połaniec substation.

signals.title: PGE, Orlen, Enea and TAURON sign letter of intent on rebuilding Ukraine's energy system
signals.summary: At the Ukraine Recovery Conference in Gdańsk, PGE, ORLEN, Enea and TAURON signed a letter of intent to help rebuild and modernise Ukraine’s war-damaged energy system. The early-stage agreement carries no financial commitments.

signals.title: OSGE and the City of Włocławek sign cooperation agreement for up to six SMRs
signals.summary: OSGE and the City of Włocławek signed a cooperation agreement on up to six BWRX-300 reactors. The project company holds a decision-in-principle and environmental scoping resolution, with siting studies under way before a permit application.

signals.title: PGE's June 2026 AGM refreshes the supervisory board after the term expires
signals.summary: At PGE’s 18 June 2026 AGM the supervisory board’s term expired and shareholders appointed seven new members; the meeting also resolved to cover the 2025 net loss of roughly PLN 6.95bn from capital reserves.

signals.unit: European Commission — RRF impact in Poland
signals.title: Commission sets out the energy impact of Poland’s €54.7bn Recovery and Resilience Plan
signals.summary: A European Commission factsheet states that Poland’s Recovery and Resilience Plan combines structural reforms with €54.7 billion of EU funding, with 40% of that funding allocated primarily to energy-related objectives.

signals.unit: Poland — KPEiK / national energy & climate plan
signals.title: Council of Ministers adopts updated KPEiK; gas confirmed as bridging fuel to 2040
signals.summary: On 8 June 2026 the Council of Ministers adopted the updated National Energy and Climate Plan, confirming gas as a bridging fuel peaking around 2030, renewables above 50% by 2030 and coal below about 5% by 2040.

links.label: pv magazine — Poland's new energy strategy

signals.title: Energa flags missed commercial-operation deadline at CCGT Grudziądz 1 and Ostrołęka
signals.summary: Energa disclosed that the contractual commercial-operation dates for CCGT Grudziądz 1 and CCGT Ostrołęka were missed, confirming slippage on two flagship ORLEN Group gas units even as first power approached.

signals.title: Ørsted and PGE begin offshore installation of the 1.5 GW Baltica 2 wind farm
signals.summary: PGE and Ørsted began offshore installation of the 1.5 GW Baltica 2 wind farm, with Van Oord placing 111 monopiles through Q4 2026 for Siemens Gamesa 14 MW turbines and commissioning expected by end-2027.

signals.title: Nuclear regulator finds Lubiatowo-Kopalino suitable for Poland's first plant
signals.summary: The president of Poland’s National Atomic Energy Agency concluded, after reviewing PEJ’s preliminary site report, that no factors preclude building a nuclear plant at Lubiatowo-Kopalino, covering seismic, hydrological, population and emergency-planning criteria.

links.label: World Nuclear News — site deemed suitable

signals.title: Energa FY2025: net profit jumps to 1.24bn zł, EBITDA 3.6bn, distribution leads
signals.summary: Energa posted 2025 net profit of PLN 1.24bn, up from PLN 376m, with EBITDA of PLN 3.6bn led by distribution. Revenue was PLN 21.1bn, capex PLN 5.6bn, and the board proposed no dividend.

signals.title: Enea's supervisory board reappoints Grzegorz Kinelski and renews the management board
signals.summary: Enea’s supervisory board reappointed the management board for a new three-year term with Grzegorz Kinelski as president, and added Eryk Kosiński and Adrian Moliński as board members from 1 July 2026.

links.label: WNP — two new Enea board members

signals.title: Energa signs GE annex resetting Ostrołęka CCGT deadline to Q1 2027 to avoid capacity penalties
signals.summary: Energa signed an annex with GE Power and GE Vernova committing to bring the Ostrołęka CCGT to its operational milestone by March 2027, protecting it from capacity-market penalties after delays at Ostrołęka and Grudziądz.

signals.title: PGE posts record 12.9bn zł EBITDA but a 3.4bn zł net loss on coal write-offs
signals.summary: PGE reported record recurring 2025 EBITDA of PLN 12.9bn, up 14%, but a net loss of PLN 3.4bn after PLN 9.9bn of non-cash coal-asset write-offs; capex exceeded PLN 11.5bn while net debt fell by PLN 1.4bn.

signals.title: Enea FY2025: net profit rises to 1.77bn zł as EBITDA slips to 5.62bn on weaker generation
signals.summary: Enea reported 2025 EBITDA of PLN 5.62bn, revenue and other income of PLN 28.1bn and net profit of PLN 1.77bn, with record capex of PLN 6.2bn and output above 20.4 TWh as Kozienice CCGT construction began.

signals.title: TAURON approves construction of ~600 MW Jaworzno OCGT and tenders the turbine island
signals.summary: TAURON’s board approved a roughly 600 MW open-cycle gas peaker at Jaworzno III, backed by a 15-year capacity contract worth about PLN 3.7bn, and tendered the turbine-island supply and long-term service package.

links.label: WNP — TAURON to build Jaworzno OCGT

signals.title: Magdalena Kamińska appointed CEO of Energa as Orlen tightens control
signals.summary: Energa’s supervisory board appointed Magdalena Kamińska president of the management board from 1 April 2026, after serving as acting CEO since November 2025; she was previously Energa’s vice-president for finance.

signals.title: PEJ files Poland's first nuclear construction-licence application with the PAA
signals.summary: PEJ submitted Poland’s first application for a nuclear construction licence to the National Atomic Energy Agency for the Lubiatowo-Kopalino plant in Pomerania; the documentation exceeds 40,000 pages and is a key pre-construction permit.

signals.title: TAURON publishes FY2025 annual report; capacity revenues support the gas capex plan
signals.summary: TAURON released its 2025 annual financial report, with capacity-market income and coal-unit margins supporting the balance sheet that funds its gas programme, including the roughly 600 MW Jaworzno OCGT due in 2030.

signals.title: Enea unveils ~PLN 2bn plan for 1.4 GW of battery storage and 300 MW of PV within 30 months
signals.summary: Enea plans 1.4 GW of battery storage and 300 MW of PV within 30 months under a roughly PLN 2bn programme, including a tender for six storage sites and planned 200 MW Połaniec and 232 MW Kozienice projects.

links.label: Renewables Now — Enea plans 1.4 GW BESS, 300 MW PV

signals.title: PGE Dystrybucja signs ~PLN 1.4bn KPO grants to modernise grids and add 541 MW of connection capacity
signals.summary: PGE Dystrybucja signed seven National Recovery Plan grant agreements worth nearly PLN 1.4bn to rebuild 504 substations and 177 km of lines, install about 58,000 smart meters and add 541 MW of renewable connection capacity.

links.label: Renewables Now — PGE gets €326m for grid upgrade

signals.title: Energa-Operator lands EIB backing for a 40bn zł grid-modernisation drive
signals.summary: Energa, part of ORLEN Group, plans to invest PLN 40bn by 2035 to modernise and digitise its distribution grid, backed by EIB loans funding about 830 km of lines and connections for 1.4 GW of renewables.

signals.title: Polimex-Mostostal and Siemens Energy win the EPC for PGE's Rybnik OCGT peaker
signals.summary: PGE Inwest 23 signed EPC and turbine-service agreements with Polimex Mostostal and Siemens Energy for an approximately 600 MWe OCGT at Rybnik, worth PLN 1.17bn plus €269.5m net, with commissioning due by 16 January 2030.

signals.title: Poland remains a net electricity importer as coal retirements accelerate
signals.summary: Poland remained a net electricity importer in 2024, importing about 15.2 TWh against 13.3 TWh exported. Up to 8 GW of coal capacity may exit after 2025 as contracts lapse, strengthening the case for flexible gas.

signals.title: OSGE and GE Vernova Hitachi sign agreement on a Polish generic BWRX-300 design
signals.summary: OSGE and GE Vernova Hitachi signed an agreement to develop a detailed Polish generic BWRX-300 design, intended as the reference design for a standardised SMR fleet, with public backing from Poland’s Energy Minister.

links.label: GE Vernova — Polish generic design agreement

signals.title: URE finds no third-party investor interest in storage assets covered by system-service consultation
signals.summary: URE’s Information 10/2026 reported that no entities other than electricity-system operators expressed interest in investing in the storage facilities covered by its consultation on the cost-effective provision of system services.

signals.title: Enea starts construction of two 668 MW CCGT units at Kozienice with Çalık Enerji
signals.summary: Enea began building two CCGT units totalling 1,336 MW at Kozienice with general contractor Çalık Enerji, which took over the site in January 2026. Commissioning is scheduled for March and June 2029; the units are hydrogen-ready.

signals.title: Axpo completes purchase of the 116 MW Nowa Sarzyna CCGT after UOKiK clearance
signals.summary: After UOKiK approval, Axpo Polska signed the final agreement to acquire 100% of Polenergia Elektrociepłownia Nowa Sarzyna, adding the 116 MW CCGT in south-eastern Poland to its flexible-generation portfolio and retaining all employees.

signals.title: US EXIM signs first credit agreement with PEJ ahead of nuclear FID
signals.summary: US EXIM signed a direct-loan credit agreement with PEJ under its Engineering Multiplier Program, financing Bechtel and Westinghouse design and engineering services as PEJ moves toward a final investment decision.

signals.title: PGE selects Polimex-Mostostal–Siemens Energy consortium for 1.2 GW of OCGT peakers at Rybnik and Gryfino
signals.summary: PGE selected a Polimex-Mostostal and Siemens Energy consortium, the sole bidder, to build two 588 MW OCGT peakers at Rybnik and Gryfino. Both units hold 15-year capacity contracts; signing awaited EU foreign-subsidies clearance.

signals.title: TAURON orders the OCGT turbine island for Jaworzno to secure a scarce delivery slot
signals.summary: TAURON launched procurement for the turbine island and a long-term service agreement for its Jaworzno peaker, aiming to secure an early manufacturer delivery slot amid multi-year waiting times for large gas turbines.

signals.title: Enea secures PLN 6.95bn project financing for the Kozienice CCGT
signals.summary: Enea’s project company Elkogaz arranged bank financing from a consortium led by Bank Gospodarstwa Krajowego to fund the two-unit Kozienice CCGT; Enea’s 2025 results release puts the project financing at PLN 6.95bn, with a KUKE guarantee.

signals.title: PGE targets 10 GW of new gas capacity — 4 GW CCGT and 6 GW OCGT — to backstop renewables
signals.summary: PGE’s strategy envisages about 10 GW of controllable gas capacity — roughly 4 GW of CCGT, including Gryfino Dolna Odra and the 882 MW Nowy Rybnik unit, and 6 GW of OCGT peakers — targeting commissioning around 2030.

links.label: Enerdata — PGE two new gas plants

signals.title: Orlen advances new CCGT units at Gdańsk and Grudziądz II, extending the gas programme
signals.summary: Beyond Grudziądz and Ostrołęka, ORLEN Group is building a new CCGT block in Gdańsk, has started Grudziądz II and is selecting technology and an EPC contractor for the Siekierki plant in Warsaw.

signals.unit: Energy Law amendment — grid connection overhaul
signals.title: Polish government approves draft law reforming grid connection rules
signals.summary: The government approved an Energy Law amendment requiring operators to publish available capacity, doubling connection deposits to PLN 60/kW, shortening connection-condition validity to one year, extending cable pooling to storage and piloting connection-capacity auctions.

links.label: Polskie Radio — grid connection reform approved

signals.title: Poland downgrades battery availability, cutting storage awards in the 2030 auction
signals.summary: Regulatory changes lowered the assumed availability of battery storage in the 2030 capacity auction, cutting BESS awards to about 685 MW, roughly 13% of assets, which favoured gas peakers and helped lift the clearing price.

signals.unit: EU Modernisation Fund — national storage programme
signals.title: Poland finalises PLN 4.15bn storage support list covering ~3,900 MW / 14,500 MWh
signals.summary: NFOŚiGW published the final list under its PLN 4.15bn Modernisation Fund programme: 172 storage facilities totalling about 3,900 MW / 14,500 MWh, to be built by end-2028, after requests reached nearly seven times the budget.

signals.title: Axpo agrees to buy Polenergia’s 116 MW Nowa Sarzyna gas plant
signals.summary: Axpo agreed to buy Polenergia’s 116 MW Nowa Sarzyna gas plant, subject to antimonopoly approval, with closing expected in early 2026. Polenergia said the sale lets it redeploy capital into major renewable projects.

signals.title: TAURON dismisses commerce VP Gołębiowski; Zawadzki delegated as acting VP Commerce
signals.summary: TAURON’s supervisory board dismissed commerce vice-president Piotr Gołębiowski effective 17 December 2025 and delegated board member Krzysztof Zawadzki to act in the role from January 2026 for up to three months.

signals.title: Gas dominates Poland's 2030 capacity auction; clearing price jumps to 465 PLN/kW-year
signals.summary: PSE’s 2030 main capacity auction contracted 6,887 MW at PLN 465.02/kW/year, more than double the previous year’s price. Gas turbines won most awards and batteries 13.4%, underpinning PGE, Enea and TAURON peaker builds.

signals.title: TAURON launches four batteries totalling ~23 MW/90 MWh on its path to 700 MW of storage by 2030
signals.summary: TAURON is commissioning four batteries totalling about 23 MW / 90 MWh at Przewóz, Dąbie, Proszowek and Kuźnia Raciborska across Q4 2025–Q1 2026, advancing its targets of 700 MW of storage by 2030 and 1.4 GW by 2035.

links.label: Renewables Now — TAURON to launch 90 MWh of storage

signals.title: Axpo acquires a standalone 32 MW / 140 MWh battery project in Mazowieckie
signals.summary: Axpo acquired a large-scale standalone battery energy-storage project in the Mazowieckie region with 32 MW of installed capacity and 140 MWh of storage capacity, according to deal counsel SSW’s energy and M&A team.

signals.title: TAURON wins ~€128m eco-fund co-financing for 346 MW of battery storage
signals.summary: TAURON qualified for about PLN 538m (≈€128m) of national eco-fund co-financing toward 346 MW / 1.5 GWh of battery storage across 11 facilities planned by 2028, complementing its Jaworzno gas peaker.

links.label: Renewables Now — TAURON 346 MW storage co-financing

signals.title: PGE dismisses CEO Dariusz Marzec; Dariusz Lubera installed as CEO from January 2026
signals.summary: PGE’s supervisory board dismissed CEO Dariusz Marzec on 8 December 2025 and appointed Dariusz Lubera as acting, then permanent, president from 15 January 2026, with Katarzyna Rozenfeld joining as vice-president for operations.

signals.title: Valmet wins the boiler-island fuel conversion for Fortum's Zabrze CHP
signals.summary: Valmet will convert the CFB boiler at Fortum’s Zabrze CHP from a 60% coal / 40% RDF mix to certified local biomass plus RDF, part of the €85m retrofit, with start-up scheduled for Q4 2027.

signals.unit: Northland Power — Mieczysławów & Kamionka (300 MW / 1.2 GWh)
signals.title: Northland Power buys two Polish BESS projects totalling 300 MW / 1.2 GWh from Greenvolt
signals.summary: Northland Power acquired two pre-construction four-hour battery projects in western Poland from Greenvolt — Mieczysławów (200 MW) and Kamionka (100 MW) — for about €200 million, backed by 17-year capacity-market contracts.

signals.title: ORLEN invites Energa shareholders to sell, seeking 100% ownership at PLN 18.87 per share
signals.summary: ORLEN invited Energa’s minority shareholders to sell their remaining 37.6 million shares at PLN 18.87 each, which would take it to 100% ownership; offers were accepted between 1 and 17 December 2025.

links.label: Reuters — Orlen buyout of Energa minorities

signals.title: Standing Committee adopts Energy Law amendment described as the first anti-blackout act
signals.summary: The Standing Committee of the Council of Ministers adopted the UC84 Energy Law amendment, the first act of the Ministry of Energy and PSE anti-blackout package, streamlining grid connections and implementing EU market-design and REMIT rules.

signals.title: Draft RES Act amendment introducing a biomethane support system enters the government work schedule
signals.summary: The Government Work Planning Team added draft bill UD332, amending the Renewable Energy Sources Act, to the Council of Ministers’ schedule; its main purpose is to introduce a dedicated support system for biomethane.

links.label: Ministry of Climate and Environment — announcement

signals.title: Fortum commits ~€85m to convert Zabrze CHP from coal to biomass and RDF
signals.summary: Fortum will invest about €85m to retrofit its Zabrze CHP plant to biomass and RDF between Q4 2025 and Q4 2027, cutting coal-based capacity by 0.1 GW and CO₂ emissions by about 280,000 tonnes a year.

signals.unit: RES Act amendment — RED II implementation
signals.title: RES Act amendment enters into force, implementing a further part of RED II and adding URE duties
signals.summary: An amended RES Act entered into force, implementing a further part of RED II across electricity and heat, extending support to renewable hydrogen and cooling, broadening the modernisation definition and giving URE new obligations.

links.label: URE — amendment of the RES Act

signals.title: DRI acquires a ready-to-build 112 MW / 448 MWh battery project at Kozienice from Greenvolt
signals.summary: DRI, DTEK’s EU renewables arm, bought Greenvolt’s ready-to-build 112 MW / 448 MWh battery project at Kozienice, with permits and grid connection secured, raising DRI’s storage capacity available to the Polish grid to 245 MW.

signals.title: TAURON secures ~€1.2bn from BGK for grid transformation and digitalisation
signals.summary: TAURON secured about PLN 4.87bn (€1.2bn) from BGK under the National Recovery Plan to modernise and digitise its distribution grid, aiming to connect nearly 1.9 GW of renewables and 2.8 GW of storage by 2030.

links.label: Renewables Now — TAURON solar & storage loan

signals.title: Commission grants Poland a derogation on the Polish capacity mechanism to 31 December 2028
signals.summary: The European Commission granted Poland a derogation from Article 22(4)(b) of Regulation 2019/943 for its capacity mechanism, applying from 1 July 2025 to 31 December 2028, published as Decision (EU) 2026/341.

signals.title: ZE PAK withdraws from selling PAK CCGT, ending negotiations with PGE
signals.summary: ZE PAK withdrew from selling 100% of PAK CCGT to PGE, ending negotiations on 30 June 2025. ZE PAK will build the CCGT with other financing, while both sides continue talks on PGE PAK Energia Jądrowa.

signals.title: Deregulation bill proposes new generation-licence rules and cable pooling for storage
signals.summary: The government’s energy-sector deregulation bill (UDER29) proposes new rules for obtaining electricity-generation licences and extends the cable-pooling formula to energy storage and other installations sharing a single grid connection point.

links.label: Dentons — deregulation in the energy sector

signals.title: Draft Energy Law amendment on connection fees and capacity blocking goes to public consultation
signals.summary: A draft Energy Law amendment targeting ‘capacity blocking’ entered public consultation, doubling the connection-fee advance to PLN 60/kW with a PLN 6m cap, adding application fees and financial security, and cutting connection-condition validity to one year.

links.label: CMS — draft law in public consultation

signals.title: Energa Operator draws final €405m EIB tranche of a PLN 3.5bn programme to expand and digitise the grid
signals.summary: The EIB signed a PLN 1.7bn (€405m) loan to ORLEN for Energa Operator, the final tranche of a PLN 3.5bn package, funding 4,600 km of grid upgrades, 2,300 km of new lines and 4.8 GW of renewable connections.

signals.title: Poland extends capacity-market participation of units above 550 kg CO₂/MWh to the end of 2028
signals.summary: Although EU rules bar units emitting over 550 kg CO₂/MWh from capacity-market aid from July 2025, Poland amended its Capacity Market Act to extend such units’ participation until the end of 2028 for system stability.

links.label: Dentons — amendments to the Capacity Market Act

signals.unit: PGE / ZE PAK — PAK CCGT term sheet
signals.title: PGE signs a term sheet to acquire 100% of PAK CCGT and 50% of PGE PAK Energia Jądrowa
signals.summary: PGE signed a term sheet with ZE PAK on acquiring 100% of PAK CCGT — a 600 MWe-class unit with a 17-year capacity contract from 2026 — and 50% of PGE PAK Energia Jądrowa, with exclusivity until June 2025.

signals.title: Poland's 2029 capacity auction clears low at 264.90 zł/kW, favouring batteries over gas
signals.summary: Poland’s 2029 main capacity auction cleared at PLN 264.90/kW/year, awarding over 8 GW including an estimated 4.2 GW of batteries, while about 1.7 GW of CCGT became uneconomic and Enea withdrew over 1.2 GW of gas.
